metadata.description: Tyama - agent skills that teach you instead of answering for you. Feynman explanations, teach-back drills, recall quizzes, spaced-repetition cards, build-project challenges, mock interviews and learning retrospectives. Cross-domain: not only code, but also welding, soldering, household electrics, Excel, Word, cooking, video editing and public speaking.

plugins.name: tyama
plugins.description: 20 tutoring skills built on one rule: AI is a multiplier for what you already understand, never a crutch for what you do not. The skills refuse to hand you a finished answer on a topic you cannot yet explain in your own words - first you say it back, then you get help.
